title: US soybean acres planted with herbicide-tolerant seed

source.name: Adoption of Genetically Engineered Crops in the U.S.

notes: Illustrative -- real published USDA ERS adoption-rate figures for herbicide-tolerant soybeans, formatted for narration. The spread of glyphosate-resistant crops let farmers spray broad-spectrum herbicide across nearly every field, which also wiped out milkweed growing between the rows -- monarchs' only host plant.
